title: Persona Adoption as Safety Bypass: Measuring the Causal Dose-Response of Persona Strength on Refusal Rates

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A dose-response characterization tells defenders exactly where to draw the line and enables a simple input filter targeting persona strength. Clear chain from measurement to actionable defense.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Creating persona prompts at five intensity levels and measuring refusal rates is simple prompt engineering. Fitting a logistic curve is basic statistics. A persona-strength classifier uses standard NLP. Fully beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tight scope: create 5 persona levels, measure refusal on a fixed set, fit a curve, optionally train a classifier. Clear single deliverable. Easily fits in 30 hours.
